Example Excellence Scholarship 2026/2027

The Example Excellence Scholarship supports international students pursuing a Master's degree (MSc) at Example University.

Eligibility

Applicants must be citizens of Indonesia, Kenya or Vietnam. Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree with a minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0.

Applicants must be under the age of 35 at the application deadline.

Applicants need at least 2 years of work experience.

English: IELTS overall score of 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90. Applicants whose previous degree was taught entirely in English may submit a medium of instruction letter, subject to admissions approval.

Benefits

The scholarship covers full tuition fees and provides a monthly stipend of EUR 1,200 per month.

A one-off travel allowance of EUR 1,000 is included. Health insurance is covered.

Application

The scholarship application deadline is 15 January 2027, 23:59 CET.

The admission application deadline is 1 December 2026.

The previous round closed on 15 January 2025.

Required documents: passport, academic transcripts, degree certificate, CV, two recommendation letters, and a motivation letter of maximum 800 words.

Essay: Describe how your studies will benefit your home community and your leadership experience (maximum 500 words).

Selection criteria: candidates are assessed on academic excellence, leadership potential and development impact.
